basis: The queue's starting corpus is kept unless another corpus that carries the same stroke count follows the dictionary's per-stroke directions more closely, as established in the grade 1 batch 24 re-review and first used for 珈 in special grade batch 1. Only differences that change the flagged-stroke count are acted on; a few degrees is noise.

髡.reason: MM writes the 髟 bars in a different order (two strokes over 60°, max 93°); the simplified file follows the dictionary with no stroke over 16°.

霍.reason: Ja writes the 隹 bars after the long vertical (three strokes over 60°, max 96°); MM leaves one at 91°.

盥.reason: Ja writes the two 臼 halves in the opposite order (three strokes over 60°, max 148°); MM follows the dictionary with no stroke over 31°.

誑.reason: Ja writes the 王 vertical before its second bar (two strokes over 60°, max 95°); MM keeps the dictionary order, max 34°.

韭.reason: Ja writes the four inner strokes of 韭 in a different order (two strokes over 60°, max 101°); the simplified file follows the dictionary, max 10°.

媾.reason: Ja writes the 冓 bars after the verticals (four strokes over 60°, max 99°); MM follows the dictionary, max 11°.

鬈.reason: MM writes both the 髟 bars and the 卷 opening differently (four strokes over 60°); the simplified file leaves two, max 96°.

虢.reason: MM leaves the 虍 opening stroke at 61°; the simplified file keeps every stroke at 60° or under.
